# Wavlon Lasers

> Industrial fiber laser cutting machines — Canadian sales, installation, and lifetime support.

Wavlon Lasers is a Canadian supplier of industrial fiber laser cutting and welding machines, based in Toronto, Ontario. We supply machines from 1kW to 30kW+ for sheet metal cutting, tube and profile cutting, and fiber laser welding applications. All machines come with Canadian-based sales, on-site installation, training, and lifetime technical support.

## Products

- [ProCut Series — Fiber Laser Sheet Cutting 3–12kW](https://wavlonlasers.com/machines/fiber-laser-sheet-cutting/pro-cut-series/)
- [PowerCut Series — Fully Enclosed Fiber Laser Sheet Cutting 3–12kW](https://wavlonlasers.com/machines/fiber-laser-sheet-cutting/power-cut-series/)
- [UltraCut Series — High-Power Fiber Laser Sheet Cutting 3–20kW](https://wavlonlasers.com/machines/fiber-laser-sheet-cutting/ultra-cut-series/)
- [TubeCut Double Chuck — Fiber Laser Tube Cutting 1.5–12kW](https://wavlonlasers.com/machines/fiber-laser-tube-cutting/double-chuck/)
- [TubeCut Triple Chuck — Heavy Duty Fiber Laser Tube Cutting 6–30kW](https://wavlonlasers.com/machines/fiber-laser-tube-cutting/triple-chuck/)
- [Air-Cooled W-Series — Fiber Laser Welding 1.5–3kW](https://wavlonlasers.com/machines/fiber-laser-welding/air-cooled-series/)

- [Fiber Laser Tube Cutting Machines](https://wavlonlasers.com/machines/fiber-laser-tube-cutting/) — how tube cutting works, tube laser vs saw and drill, sizing by diameter/length/power, Double Chuck vs Triple Chuck

## Key Facts

- Canadian company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario
- Machines available from 1kW entry-level to 30kW+ heavy industrial
- On-site installation and training across Canada
- Lifetime technical support included with every machine
- Applications: automotive, structural steel, HVAC, aerospace, agriculture, custom fabrication
